steps.content: In the darkness, all you can see is this young girl in front of you. Under her icy gaze, a series of obscure words crawls into your body, crashing your head, screaming to tear your soul apart.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's your power. Awaken it. I'm sure you can control it.

steps.speaker: S-019
steps.content: Find your shackles and <color=#fb9259>bind me</color>. Follow your instincts. This is why you exist.
Your hand starts to move uncontrollably and strangles the girl's neck. A scorching pain follows, while some crimson pattern surfaces on your skin.
The scorching pattern spreads to the young girl's skin, then stretches greedily beyond, piercing through the darkness and spreading through the entire space.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No! Stay away from me! No!!!
The crimson pattern creeps up Hella and binds her entire body like burning shackles, making it impossible for her to break free.
And the young girl who calls herself S-019 stares intently into your eyes in the same spot.
For a moment, you have grabbed hold of some strong power, like a glimpse of some insane madness...
